intro.title: How it works

single.title: Multiple choice
single.text: Pick the one right answer. A faster answer earns more points.

multi.title: Multiple answers
multi.text: More than one answer can be right. Select all of them, then confirm.

estimation.title: Estimate
estimation.text_margin: Fill in a number. If you are within the margin you score: the closer you are, the more points you get.
estimation.text_closest: Fill in a number. Whoever is closest gets all the points, everyone else gets nothing.
estimation.text_mixed: Fill in a number. On some questions you get more points the closer you are, on others only the closest player scores.

puzzle.title: Puzzle
puzzle.text: 12 words form 3 groups of 4. Work out what each group has in common and type the 3 connections.

pin.title: Pin on the map
pin.text: Tap the spot on the image. The closer your pin, the more points you get.

challenge.title: Top challenge
challenge.text: Some questions are only for the best players: the top {{percent}}% of the players ({{count}} of {{total}}) get them, on their own device. Right answer: you keep your points. Wrong or no answer: it can cost you points.
